description: Address review issues: fix N+1 read_receipts query, fix BigInt comparison for Snowflake IDs, remove dead EmptyState component, add staleness guard on read endpoint.
steps: 1. Fix N+1 in read_receipts serializer method: filter in Ruby on preloaded data instead of issuing SQL query.
2. Fix BigInt comparison in message_list.tsx for Snowflake IDs, add pending guard.
3. Remove dead empty_state.tsx component and its i18n keys and CSS.
4. Add staleness guard in chat_rooms_controller.rb read action to skip broadcast if last_read unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Serializer filters read_receipts in Ruby using select on preloaded association
message_list.tsx uses BigInt comparison and !message.pending guard
dm.empty_state.* keys removed from en.json and ko.json
read action only broadcasts when last_read_message_id actually changes
findings: All four review issues addressed. TypeScript compiles cleanly. No pre-existing test failures.
